text:
Roe v. Wade is highly controversial because the Court held that the Fourteenth Amendment’s protection of personal liberty includes a right to privacy broad enough to cover a woman’s decision whether to end a pregnancy, and therefore struck down Texas’s restriction on that decision. Supporters treat that holding as a necessary protection of bodily autonomy; opponents treat it as the Court authorizing the ending of unborn life and inventing an unenumerated right through substantive due process rather than the Constitution’s text and history. That conflict organized American politics for fifty years until Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization overruled Roe in 2022 and returned abortion regulation to elected legislatures.

CONFIDENCE: 93
